title: Toad in the Hole
description: A classic British dish made with sausages cooked in a Yorkshire pudding batter, inspired by French cuisine.
instructions: 2. Sift the flour into a bowl and make a well in the center.
3. Crack the eggs into the well and add a splash of milk, whisking until smooth.
4. Add the water, butter, salt, and pepper, whisking until the batter is smooth.
5. Cook the sausages in a pan over medium heat until browned on all sides.
6. Pour the batter over the sausages in the pan.
7. Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the batter is golden brown.
8. Serve the toad in the hole hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
